title: Photo: hand holding an unlit candle
summary: A full-slide photograph of a hand holding a tall, thin, unlit candle with a dark wick, casting a shadow of the hand and candle on a plain wall. No words on the slide.

pictures.description: Close photograph of a man's hand gripping a slender, hand-dipped taper candle with swirls of orange, yellow and purple colour in the wax. The wick is dark and unlit. The hand and candle cast a shadow on a plain beige wall behind.
